summary: Valuence Merger Corp. I, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing its board approved a one-month extension to complete an initial business combination, moving the deadline from May 3, 2026 to June 3, 2026. The company deposited $13,897.14 into its trust account to fund the extension. The charter allows up to 10 such monthly extensions, extending to March 3, 2027. No deal terms are stated; the extension protects the trust while seeking a target. For risk-arb, watch for announcement of a definitive merger agreement; lack of progress may lead to liquidation.
